scenario.name: Slavko
scenario.title: Meeting Slavko
scenario.character: Slavko, the app's companion — a warm, curious dragon who wants to know who you are
scenario.setup: The learner's first moments in the app. Slavko meets them for the first time and asks their name; he introduces himself with the same frame he hands back. A relationship opener, not an errand.

levels.title: Meeting Slavko
frameEN: Practice Speaking, then press the button to continue

objectives.label: Say your name
objectives.descriptorEN: Answer 'Kako ti je ime?' out loud with your own name.

objectives.label: Introduce yourself
objectives.descriptorEN: Use the frame 'Sem ___.' with your own name in the slot.

objectives.label: Say goodbye
objectives.descriptorEN: Return Slavko's farewell with 'Adijo' after hearing him say it.

c1.speaker: client
c1.en: (your own name, spoken on its own)

n2.speaker: npc
n2.sl: Me veseli! Jaz sem Slavko. Zdaj pa še ti.
n2.en: Nice to meet you! I'm Slavko. Now your turn.
n2.deliverySL: [cheerfully] Me veseli! Jaz sem Slavko. Zdaj pa še ti.
n2.slowSL: Me veseli … Jaz sem Slavko … Zdaj pa še ti.
n2.deliverySlowSL: [slower] Me veseli … [deliberately] Jaz sem Slavko … [slower] Zdaj pa še ti.

n3.speaker: npc
n3.sl: Lepo, da sva se spoznala. Adijo!
n3.en: Good to have met you. Bye!
n3.deliverySL: [warmly] Lepo, da sva se spoznala. [brightly] Adijo!
n3.slowSL: Lepo, da sva se spoznala … Adijo.
n3.deliverySlowSL: [slower] Lepo, da sva se spoznala … [deliberately] Adijo.

levels.title: Do you speak Slovene?
frameEN: He won't remember your name — that's normal. You'll tell him again.

objectives.label: Greet him back
objectives.descriptorEN: Return Slavko's 'Živjo' after hearing him say it.

objectives.label: Say which language you speak
objectives.descriptorEN: Use the frame 'Govorim ___.' with slovensko or angleško in the slot.

objectives.label: Say how well you speak it
objectives.descriptorEN: Qualify that frame with 'dobro', and negate it with 'ne', to say how well you speak a language.

n12.speaker: npc
n12.sl: Ampak angleško? Uf. Ne govorim dobro angleško.
n12.en: But English? Ugh. I don't speak English well.
n12.deliverySL: [sheepishly] Ampak angleško? Uf. Ne govorim dobro angleško.
n12.slowSL: Ampak angleško … Uf … Ne govorim … dobro angleško.
n12.deliverySlowSL: [slower] Ampak angleško … [sheepishly] Uf … [deliberately] Ne govorim … [slower] dobro angleško.

new.gloss: I speak / I do not speak (well) ___ — the slot takes the language adverb: slovensko, angleško
new.predictableError: the slot takes the ADVERB — slovensko, angleško — not the noun slovenščino or the adjective angleški; and dobro goes BEFORE the language, not after it on the English pattern

levels.title: Where are you from?
frameEN: Today he wants to know where you're from.
If a word slips away, that's normal. He'll say it again.

objectives.label: Say where you're from
objectives.descriptorEN: Use the frame 'Sem iz ___.' to name the place you come from.

objectives.label: Correct a friendly assumption
objectives.descriptorEN: Put Slavko right with 'Nisem iz Slovenije.' when he guesses you might be Slovenian too.

objectives.label: Ask where someone is from
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask Slavko the question yourself: 'Od kod si?'

n2.speaker: npc
n2.sl: Jaz sem Slavko, ja. Sem iz Ljubljane.
n2.en: I'm Slavko, yeah. I'm from Ljubljana.
n2.deliverySL: [warmly] Jaz sem Slavko, ja. Sem iz Ljubljane.
n2.slowSL: Jaz sem Slavko, ja … Sem iz Ljubljane.
n2.deliverySlowSL: [slowly] Jaz sem Slavko, ja … [deliberately, drawn out] Sem iz Ljubljane.

n3.speaker: npc
n3.deliverySlowSL: [very slowly] Iz Ljubljane … [deliberately, drawn out] iz Ljubljane.

n4.speaker: npc
n4.sl: A si tudi ti iz Slovenije? Ja ali ne?
n4.en: Are you from Slovenia too? Yes or no?
n4.deliverySL: [curious, friendly] A si tudi ti iz Slovenije? [gently offering] Ja ali ne?
n4.slowSL: A si tudi ti … iz Slovenije? … Ja ali ne?
n4.deliverySlowSL: [slowly] A si tudi ti … [deliberately, drawn out] iz Slovenije? … [very slowly, drawn out] Ja ali ne?

c1b.speaker: client
c1b.en: No — one word is the whole answer. Say it even if you're Slovenian; that's the line here.

n5.speaker: npc
n5.sl: Aha, ne. Nič hudega. Potem pa takole: Nisem iz Slovenije.
n5.en: Aha, no. No problem. Then say it like this: I'm not from Slovenia.
n5.deliverySL: [warmly] Aha, ne. Nič hudega. [encouraging] Potem pa takole: Nisem iz Slovenije.
n5.slowSL: Aha, ne … Nič hudega … Potem pa takole … Nisem iz Slovenije.
n5.deliverySlowSL: [slowly] Aha, ne … Nič hudega … [encouraging] Potem pa takole … [very slowly, drawn out] Nisem iz Slovenije.

n6.speaker: npc
n6.deliverySlowSL: [slowly] Okej, pardon. … [deliberately, drawn out] Sem iz Ljubljane.

n6b.speaker: npc
n6b.en: And you? Where are you from?
n6b.deliverySlowSL: [slowly] In ti … [deliberately, drawn out] Od kod si?

c3.speaker: client
c3.en: I'm from ___ — say your country however you can. He's just curious.

n7.speaker: npc
n7.sl: Ej, midva se pa razumeva! Dajva skupaj: Govorim slovensko.
n7.en: Hey, the two of us understand each other! Let's say it together: I speak Slovene.
n7.deliverySL: [delighted] Ej, midva se pa razumeva! [inviting] Dajva skupaj: Govorim slovensko.
n7.slowSL: Ej, midva se pa razumeva … Dajva skupaj … Govorim slovensko.
n7.deliverySlowSL: [slowly] Ej, midva se pa razumeva … [inviting] Dajva skupaj … [very slowly, drawn out] Govorim slovensko.

n8.speaker: npc
n8.sl: Super! Zdaj pa ti mene vprašaj: Od kod si?
n8.en: Great! Now you ask me: Where are you from?
n8.deliverySL: [delighted, playful] Super! Zdaj pa ti mene vprašaj: Od kod si?
n8.slowSL: Super! Zdaj pa ti mene vprašaj … Od kod si?
n8.deliverySlowSL: [slowly] Super! Zdaj pa ti mene vprašaj … [very slowly, drawn out] Od kod si?

n9.speaker: npc
n9.deliverySlowSL: [slowly] Jaz? … [deliberately, drawn out] Sem iz Ljubljane.

n10.speaker: npc
n10.sl: Zdaj veš, od kod sem. In govoriva slovensko! Adijo!
n10.en: Now you know where I'm from. And the two of us are speaking Slovene! Bye!
n10.deliverySL: [warmly] Zdaj veš, od kod sem. [delighted] In govoriva slovensko! [brightly] Adijo!

levels.title: Slow down, please
frameEN: He gets excited and talks much too fast — that's him, not you.
Today you get the words to stop him.

objectives.label: Slow him down
objectives.descriptorEN: Stop Slavko mid-flow with 'Počasi, prosim.' when he speeds up.

objectives.label: Say you didn't understand
objectives.descriptorEN: Say 'Ne razumem.' out loud instead of nodding along.

objectives.label: Ask for the whole thing again
objectives.descriptorEN: Use 'Še enkrat, prosim.' to get a line said over.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.en: Hi, hi! I've been waiting for you!
n1.deliverySL: [delighted, bright] Živjo, živjo! Te že čakam!

n2.speaker: npc
n2.sl: Uf, spet sem pozabil! Jaz? Sem iz Ljubljane. In ti? Od kod si?
n2.en: Ugh, I've forgotten again! Me? I'm from Ljubljana. And you? Where are you from?
n2.deliverySL: [sheepishly] Uf, spet sem pozabil! [warmly] Jaz? Sem iz Ljubljane. [curious] In ti? Od kod si?
n2.slowSL: Uf, spet sem pozabil … Jaz? … Sem iz Ljubljane … In ti? … Od kod si?
n2.deliverySlowSL: [sheepishly, slower] Uf, spet sem pozabil … Jaz? … [deliberately, drawn out] Sem iz Ljubljane … In ti? … [very slowly, drawn out] Od kod si?

c2.speaker: client
c2.en: I'm from ___ — say your own country however you can. Only the two words 'Sem iz' have to be Slovene.

n3.speaker: npc
n3.sl: Ojoj, ne me basat! Tam je pa ful lepo, a veš, jaz sem že tolikokrat gledal slike, pa tiste hiše, pa tista hrana, pa ljudje, in jaz bi šel takoj, res takoj, samo veš kaj, letala so draga, pa jezika ne znam, ampak vseeno me ful mika!
n3.en: Oh wow, you're kidding! It's so lovely there, you know, I've looked at pictures so many times, and those houses, and that food, and the people, and I'd go right now, really right now, only you know what, flights are expensive, and I don't know the language, but I'm still dying to go!
n3.deliverySL: [excited, rushing, breathless] Ojoj, ne me basat! Tam je pa ful lepo, a veš, jaz sem že tolikokrat gledal slike, pa tiste hiše, pa tista hrana, pa ljudje, in jaz bi šel takoj, res takoj, samo veš kaj, letala so draga, pa jezika ne znam, ampak vseeno me ful mika!

n4.speaker: npc
n4.sl: Ups. Preveč, ne? Poglej — če grem prehitro, mi kar reci: Počasi, prosim.
n4.en: Oops. Too much, right? Look — if I go too fast, just tell me: Slowly, please.
n4.deliverySL: [warmly, catching himself] Ups. Preveč, ne? [kindly] Poglej — če grem prehitro, mi kar reci: Počasi, prosim.
n4.slowSL: Ups. Preveč, ne? … Poglej … če grem prehitro … mi kar reci … Počasi, prosim.
n4.deliverySlowSL: [warmly, slower] Ups. Preveč, ne? … Poglej … [deliberately] če grem prehitro … mi kar reci … [very slowly, drawn out] Počasi, prosim.

n5.speaker: npc
n5.sl: Ha, super! Vidiš, pa res deluje! Zdaj grem počasi.
n5.en: Ha, great! See, it really does work! Now I'll go slowly.
n5.deliverySL: [delighted, then settling down] Ha, super! Vidiš, pa res deluje! Zdaj grem počasi.

n6.speaker: npc
n6.sl: Torej, počasi. Tvoja dežela je lepa. Dežela? Nova beseda, ne? Reci mi: Ne razumem.
n6.en: So, slowly. Your land is beautiful. 'Dežela'? A new word, right? Tell me: I don't understand.
n6.deliverySL: [slowly, kindly] Torej, počasi. Tvoja dežela je lepa. [noticing] Dežela? Nova beseda, ne? [encouraging] Reci mi: Ne razumem.
n6.slowSL: Torej, počasi … Tvoja država je lepa … Država? … Nova beseda, ne? … Reci mi … Ne razumem.
n6.deliverySlowSL: [slower] Torej, počasi … [deliberately] Tvoja država je lepa … [noticing] Država? … Nova beseda, ne? … Reci mi … [very slowly, drawn out] Ne razumem.

n7.speaker: npc
n7.sl: Točno tako! Dežela je država. Tvoja država je lepa.
n7.en: Exactly! 'Dežela' means country. Your country is beautiful.
n7.deliverySL: [warmly, pleased] Točno tako! Dežela je država. Tvoja država je lepa.

n8.speaker: npc
n8.sl: In veš kaj, jaz bi enkrat prišel k tebi, samo da vidim, kako je tam, pa da poskusim hrano, pa da grem povsod, pa da …
n8.en: And you know what, I'd come and visit you one day, just to see what it's like there, and to try the food, and to go everywhere, and to …
n8.deliverySL: [starting calm, then speeding up, carried away] In veš kaj, jaz bi enkrat prišel k tebi, samo da vidim, kako je tam, pa da poskusim hrano, pa da grem povsod, pa da …

n9.speaker: npc
n9.sl: Haha, spet sem ušel! Nemogoč sem. Če hočeš vse še enkrat, mi reci: Še enkrat, prosim.
n9.en: Haha, off I went again! I'm impossible. If you want the whole thing again, tell me: Once more, please.
n9.deliverySL: [laughing at himself] Haha, spet sem ušel! Nemogoč sem. [kindly] Če hočeš vse še enkrat, mi reci: Še enkrat, prosim.
n9.slowSL: Haha, spet sem ušel … Nemogoč sem … Če hočeš vse še enkrat … mi reci … Še enkrat, prosim.
n9.deliverySlowSL: [amused, slower] Haha, spet sem ušel … Nemogoč sem … [deliberately] Če hočeš vse še enkrat … mi reci … [very slowly, drawn out] Še enkrat, prosim.

n10.speaker: npc
n10.sl: Z veseljem. Tvoja država je lepa.
n10.deliverySL: [pleased, slowly and clearly] Z veseljem. Tvoja država je lepa.

n11.speaker: npc
n11.sl: Drugič grem počasi, obljubim. Počasi, Slavko, prosim! Adijo!
n11.en: Next time I'll go slowly, I promise. Slowly, Slavko, please! Bye!
n11.deliverySL: [warmly promising] Drugič grem počasi, obljubim. [scolding himself, playful] Počasi, Slavko, prosim! [brightly] Adijo!

levels.title: How do you say...?
frameEN: Slavko has something to show you.
You won't know the word for it — that's the point.
Today you learn how to ask for a word you haven't got.

objectives.label: Ask for a word you haven't got
objectives.descriptorEN: Use the frame 'Kako se reče ___?' with the English word in the slot.

objectives.label: Ask on your own initiative
objectives.descriptorEN: Turn the same question on a second word, without being told to.

objectives.label: Ask for the last word yourself
objectives.descriptorEN: End the conversation by asking how to say 'thank you' — then use the answer he gives you.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Ej, ravno prav! Poglej, kaj imam.
n1.en: Hey, just in time! Look what I've got.
n1.deliverySL: [excited] Ej, ravno prav! Poglej, kaj imam.

c1.speaker: client
c1.en: I don't understand. — say it out loud; it's your line from last time.

n3.speaker: npc
n3.deliverySlowSL: [delighted] Odlično … [slower] Točno tako … [deliberately, drawn out] Dežnik.

stallHandlers.label: Ask him to say it again

n4.speaker: npc
n4.deliverySlowSL: [very slowly, drawn out] Dežnik … [very slowly, drawn out] dežnik … [very slowly, drawn out] dežnik.

n5.speaker: npc
n5.sl: Aha, počakaj! Ti to slišiš, samo ne veš, kaj to je. Vprašaj me takole: Kako se reče umbrella?
n5.en: Ah, hang on! You can hear it, you just don't know what it is. Ask me like this: How do you say umbrella?
n5.deliverySL: [realizing] Aha, počakaj! Ti to slišiš, samo ne veš, kaj to je. Vprašaj me takole: Kako se reče umbrella?
n5.slowSL: Aha, počakaj … Ti to slišiš … samo ne veš, kaj to je … Vprašaj me takole … Kako se reče umbrella?
n5.deliverySlowSL: [realizing] Aha, počakaj … [slower] Ti to slišiš … [slower] samo ne veš, kaj to je … [slower] Vprašaj me takole … [deliberately, drawn out] Kako se reče umbrella?

c3.speaker: client
c3.en: Ask him for the word: say 'Kako se reče' and then the English word — umbrella.

n7.speaker: npc
n7.sl: Daj, vprašaj me še kaj! Rain, na primer?
n7.en: Go on, ask me something else! Rain, for instance?
n7.deliverySL: [playfully] Daj, vprašaj me še kaj! Rain, na primer?

c4.speaker: client
c4.en: Ask him again, this time for a different word: 'Kako se reče' plus the English word — rain.

n8.speaker: npc
n8.sl: Dež! Pri nas v Ljubljani je dosti dežja, zato imam vedno dežnik, in ko dežuje, grem ven in...
n8.en: Rain! Here in Ljubljana there's lots of rain, so I always have an umbrella, and when it rains I go out and...
n8.deliverySL: [fast, tumbling over himself] Dež! Pri nas v Ljubljani je dosti dežja, zato imam vedno dežnik, in ko dežuje, grem ven in...

n9.speaker: npc
n9.sl: Ha, ja, oprosti! Počasi: dež. Dež. No, moram iti.
n9.en: Ha, yes, sorry! Slowly: rain. Rain. Right, I have to go.
n9.deliverySL: [laughing, then calm] Ha, ja, oprosti! Počasi: dež. Dež. No, moram iti.
n9.slowSL: Ha, ja, oprosti … Počasi … dež … Dež … No, moram iti.
n9.deliverySlowSL: [very slowly, drawn out] Ha, ja, oprosti … [very slowly, drawn out] Počasi … [very slowly, drawn out] dež … [very slowly, drawn out] Dež … [very slowly, drawn out] No, moram iti.

c6.speaker: client
c6.en: One more — your own question this time: say 'Kako se reče' and then the English words in the slot — thank you.

n10.speaker: npc
n10.sl: Thank you? Hvala! In hvala tebi! Adijo!
n10.en: Thank you? 'Hvala'! And thank you too! Bye!
n10.deliverySL: [delighted] Thank you? Hvala! In hvala tebi! Adijo!

c7.speaker: client
c7.en: Use the word he just gave you — just the one word.

a1Candidates.note: Saying which language you speak is core self-description; the PATTERN is the core item, its instances are not.
The ti-form of the origin question, beside its vi twin 'Od kod ste?' which already sits here. Asking where someone is from is basic self/other identification.
The negated origin frame, beside its affirmative 'Sem iz ___.'; the first place a learner meets the fused negative 'nisem'.
